highlights: Consequently, consolidated EBITDA declined 2% YoY and 7% QoQ to Rs 1,368 Cr, 4% below our estimates, with margins contracting 460bps YoY and 230bps QoQ to 28.9%.

Within thermal, growth was led by Ghatampur (Neyveli UP Power Ltd JV – 51:49), where generation more than doubled to 1,780 MU (Q2FY26: 815 MU) and rose 16% QoQ in its first full quarter at the full 1,980 MW (3x660 MW) capacity, although its PLF of 41.0% (Q1FY27: 35.3%) remains well below normative levels as the new units stabilise.

Sector Outlook: Cautiously Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: NLCIL has ambitious capacity expansion plans, aiming to increase its current mining capacity from 50 MTPA to 104 MTPA by 2030, thermal power capacity from 5,960 MW to 10,020 MW, and RE capacity from 1,734 MW to 10,110 MW.
These capacity additions will require a substantial capex of over Rs 1.0 Lc Cr, which is expected to drive growth in both regulated and non-regulated equity.
valuation: Result Update 05th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 305 NLC India Limited Utilities 1 Soft Q1; Capacity Gains Offset by Seasonal Headwinds Est.
